profile_text.body:
Khan Academy is a nonprofit organization that operates an online educational platform, accessible at khanacademy.org. The site text harvested from the company's own website was limited, returning only a client challenge response rather than substantive content, so details about its programs and reach are not available from that source.

The held facts identify one AI product associated with Khan Academy: Khanmigo, categorized under Education and Research AI. It is described as an educational AI tutor, with noted considerations around student interaction data, COPPA compliance, and pedagogical bias. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the held data.
